items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Because she used to take care of all my calls over the farm.

ctx.x: Ask him who, ask him what year his sister died.

What year your sister died? I'm not sick. I'm dying. What is that? I'm 19… Oh, I'm 19… Oh, I'm 19… 21, 19, 22. I'm 19. Because she used to take care of all my calls over the farm. And I started to sign up a job over the farm. And she told me that was her last job. The last time that she was gone. Help me out because she was gone. Next day she died. Uh… Uh… How suddenly…
